name: Pac Bo
summary: Walk Coc Bo cave and the Lenin stream at Pac Bo, about 55 km north of Cao Bang city. The cave is small, and the stream runs in front of it. Give the visit a half day from town, including the drive. Do not add Ban Gioc. The roads leave in different directions. The fee is check on arrival.
timeNeeded: Half a day from the city, including the drive
getThere: About 55 km north of Cao Bang city on provincial road 203.
heroCaption: The Lenin stream at Pac Bo, under the forested hill

notice.title: Not the same afternoon as the falls
notice.body: Pac Bo is about 55 km north. Ban Gioc is more than 80 km east. A plan that puts both on one afternoon misses one of them.

body: Pac Bo means the mouth of the spring. It sits at Truong Ha, in Ha Quang, at km 0 of the Ho Chi Minh Road, about 55 km north of the city on provincial road 203. Coc Bo is the cave where Ho Chi Minh stayed from 8 February 1941 to the middle of March 1941. The floor is about 80 square metres, and the mouth fits one person.

He named the stream in front of the cave Lenin, and the hill beside it Karl Marx. A restored stone table, about 80 by 50 cm and about 60 cm high, stands outside where he worked. The original table has been in the Ho Chi Minh Museum since 1978. The site was listed as a special national relic on 10 May 2012.
Go in daylight. Minutes on the road and minutes inside the gate are check on arrival. The fee is check on arrival.

gettingThere: Pac Bo is at Truong Ha, in Ha Quang, about 55 km north of Cao Bang city on provincial road 203. Hire a car or a motorbike in the city. Minutes on the road are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Cao Bang city
legs.body: North on provincial road 203, about 55 km. The half day includes this drive. A local bus is check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: Come to Cao Bang city first. Pac Bo is a further 55 km north the next day, not a stop on the way into town.
